# codex-browser-use

> Fast, free, MIT open-source local Chrome MCP server that lets AI coding agents control your real signed-in Chrome browser.

## Core Capabilities

- Runs inside your active Chrome browser with existing cookies, logins, and developer extensions ready.
- Cuts token usage by ~52% by replacing heavy HTML dumps with compact accessibility outlines and scoped subtree snapshots.
- Isolates agent tabs inside named, color-coded Chrome Tab Groups while keeping your personal tabs untouched.
- Executes multi-step flows inside a single persistent `browser_run` call (up to 300s timeout) with local file export helpers.
- Pauses cleanly on login walls, 2FA, or CAPTCHAs via tab handoff without attempting security bypasses.
- 100% local on Node.js 26+ and Chrome, Edge, or Brave with zero cloud accounts or telemetry.

## Supported Coding Agents

- Antigravity
- Claude Code
- OpenAI Codex
- Cursor
- Windsurf
- GitHub Copilot CLI
- Command Code
- OpenCode

## Quick Install

```sh
node mcp-server/bin/browser-use.js install --skill
```
